behavior.onMissingListener: emit gateway.state WAITING_GTHINK_LISTENER; keep transport unchanged
behavior.onConfigDrift: emit method.violation and reject drift as canonical state
behavior.onUiFailure: classify UI separately; never change transport automatically
behavior.onMemoryFailure: classify person-memory separately; never change responder automatically
behavior.onTimeout: report listener/response timeout; never invent fallback transport
